supervisor.bash.contents:
printf 'ANCHOR:%s\n' "$BASHPID" >&9
exec 6<&0 5<&- 7<&-
"$2" --noprofile --norc -c "$1" shell <&6 6<&- 8<&- &
subject=$!
printf 'SUBJECT:%s\n' "$subject" >&9
exec 0<&- 6<&- 1>&- 2>&- 3<&- 4<&-
wait "$subject"
status=$?
printf 'SUBJECT_EXIT:%s\n' "$status" >&9
IFS= read -r release <&8
[[ $release == release ]] || exit 99
exit "$status"
